annotations.title: Total what you pay for AI subscriptions

description: Adds up a list of AI subscriptions and returns the monthly, yearly and daily total, where the user is paying twice for the same thing (overlaps), what could be cut and how much that saves, plus a link that opens the shareable receipt. Use plan keys from the plans tool, for example chatgpt.plus, claude.pro, cursor.pro. Append ":y" to a key for yearly billing.

billing.description: Which total the shared receipt shows first. Default monthly.

plans.description: Plan keys, e.g. ["chatgpt.plus","claude.pro","cursor.pro"]. In a GET query use a comma-separated list.

name: aitab_total
